errors.name: NotOperator

errors.name: NotAttester

errors.name: BadPair

errors.name: BadDecimals

errors.name: ZeroAmount

errors.name: Slippage

errors.name: SkewExceedsSpread

errors.name: MathOverflow

errors.name: LengthMismatch

errors.name: NotWritable

types.name: CalibrationInput
docs: Instruction argument for `set_calibration`.

types.name: CalibrationRecord
docs: Calibration record for one forecaster. PDA seeded by the maker and the
model id. Field meanings follow the Solidity interface in `../../evm`.

fields.name: alpha_bps
docs: Mean absolute error between forecast and realized outcome, in bps.

fields.name: phi_bps
docs: Informed fraction of order flow the maker assumes, in bps.

fields.name: sample_size
docs: Number of resolved forecasts the error is measured on.

fields.name: excluded
docs: Forecasts excluded from the sample, disclosed so `sample_size` cannot
silently shrink to the convenient subset.

fields.name: measured_at
docs: Unix time the record was produced. Not in the future, not before
`earliest_resolution`.

fields.name: earliest_resolution
docs: Unix time of the earliest question resolution in the sample.

fields.name: training_cutoff
docs: Unix time of the forecaster's knowledge cutoff, or 0 if none.

fields.name: dataset_hash
docs: Hash of the canonical per-forecast record set.

types.name: CollateralMarker
docs: Marks a mint as collateral for this maker, so it can never become an
outcome mint. PDA seeded by the maker and the mint.

types.name: Maker
docs: One maker: a role pair and the record rules it enforces. Program derived
address (PDA) seeded by the operator, so one maker per operator key.

fields.name: quote_signer
docs: Key the offchain quoting engine co-signs `swap_with_quote` with.
`Pubkey::default()` disables the signed path.

fields.name: max_record_age
docs: Seconds a calibration record stays valid after `measured_at`.

types.name: Market
docs: One market: the pair (collateral mint, outcome mint). PDA seeded by the
maker and the outcome mint, so an outcome mint belongs to one market.
Token vaults are the associated token accounts of this PDA.

fields.name: forecast_bps
docs: Forecaster's probability estimate, in basis points (bps).

fields.name: operator_spread_bps
docs: Spread the operator would like; the floor may override it.

fields.name: skew_bps_per_unit
docs: Bps of mid shift per whole outcome token held (beta).

fields.name: inventory_limit
docs: Q_max in outcome token base units.

fields.name: position
docs: Net outcome tokens from fills and operator deposits and withdrawals,
in base units. Positive means the maker is long the outcome.

types.name: Quote
docs: Return value of the `quote_bps` view.

types.name: QuoteParams
docs: Stored-parameter quote inputs, used one market at a time or in a batch.

types.name: SignedQuote
docs: A quote produced offchain. The quoting engine authorises it by co-signing
the transaction with `Maker::quote_signer`, so the quote is bound to this
exact transaction and cannot be replayed or altered.

fields.name: bid_bps
docs: Price at which the maker buys the outcome token, in bps.

fields.name: ask_bps
docs: Price at which the maker sells it. `ask - bid` must be at least the floor.

fields.name: max_outcome_out
docs: Most outcome tokens the maker will sell on this quote, base units.

fields.name: max_outcome_in
docs: Most outcome tokens the maker will buy on this quote, base units.

fields.name: expiry
docs: Unix time after which the quote is refused.
